title: Existing deferred compensation plans.
bodyText: This chapter shall not affect any existing deferred compensation plan established under section 457 of the Internal Revenue Code, as amended.
bodyHtml: [§88E-15]  Existing deferred compensation plans.  This chapter shall not affect any existing deferred compensation plan established under section 457 of the Internal Revenue Code, as amended. [L Sp 1981 1st, c 7, pt of §1]
